app.title: Xianyu Visual Monitor
banner.baseline_mode: Baseline mode: observed conversations are recorded as historical customers; no new-customer alerts are sent.
banner.challenge: A login or verification prompt was detected. Owner action is required; the monitor never solves or bypasses it.
banner.dry_run: Dry-run mode: emails and replies are recorded but not sent.
banner.monitor_paused: Monitoring is paused by an administrator.
banner.replies_paused: Automatic replies are paused (reason: {reason}). Review and resume on the Overview page.
banner.worker_stale: The capture worker has not reported recently. Status below may be outdated; absence of alerts does not mean absence of messages.
calibration.anchors_updated: Anchors updated from the latest frame.
calibration.capture_anchors_hint: Only do this while the chat page is in its normal layout.
calibration.intro: Regions are pixel boxes [left, top, right, bottom] in the captured frame; row fields are relative to each row. A frame of a different size is reported as a layout mismatch, never rescaled.
calibration.need_profile_and_frame: An active profile and a captured frame are required.
calibration.no_frame: No frame captured yet. Start the worker; it saves the latest frame even before calibration.
calibration.size_mismatch: The latest frame size does not match the profile.
common.name: Name
control.challenge_still_active: A verification prompt is still detected; replies remain blocked while it is visible.
control.confirm_required: Confirmation required: type {word} to apply this change.
control.mode_hint: Seed the baseline in baseline mode before switching to active mode. The visible first screen is not a complete customer history.
control.reply_send_hint: When enabled, approved or automatic replies click and type on the existing desktop. Opening a conversation marks it read.
customers.import_hint: One display name per line. Imported names become baseline customers and never trigger new-customer emails.
customers.intro: Customers are internal identities; display names are aliases. Nothing is merged automatically.
customers.merge_hint: Moves aliases, avatar fingerprints and history to the target. Use only when you are sure both are the same person.
customers.notify_exists: A notification job already exists for this customer; retry it from Notifications if needed.
customers.notify_hint: At most one notification job exists per customer.
diagnostics.export_hint: Contains settings without secrets, health state, frame timings and event statistics. Names are pseudonymized and message text is omitted. The frame option adds only badge/anchor regions.
email.alert.intro: The monitor needs the owner's attention. Automatic replies are paused where relevant.
email.alert.subject: [Xianyu monitor] Attention required: {reason}
email.field.name: Display name (OCR)
email.new_customer.intro: A conversation from a customer who is not in the stored baseline was observed. This means first observed by this monitor, not proof of first-ever contact.
email.new_customer.limitations: Limitations: the preview is the visible list text only and may be truncated, outdated or an outgoing message. Screenshot monitoring can miss conversations that are off-screen or read on another device.
email.new_customer.subject: [Xianyu monitor] New customer conversation: {name}
email.test.body: This is a test message sent from the admin UI.
email.test.subject: [Xianyu monitor] SMTP test
footer.limitations: Screenshot/OCR monitoring only sees what is visible on screen. It cannot guarantee complete message history, stable identity from nicknames, or invisibility to the platform.
jobs.action_not_allowed: That action is not allowed in the job's current state.
login.failed: Sign-in failed or account temporarily locked.
login.title: Sign in
notifications.intro: SMTP acceptance is not proof of delivery. Jobs interrupted while submitting are marked uncertain and are only resent by you.
obs.intro: Detected changes in visible conversation rows. These are observations, not a complete message log: intermediate messages can be replaced before a capture.
overview.low_disk: Low free disk space: frame saving stopped.
overview.overall_unread_hint: The overall unread total is informational only. It can stay unchanged while a conversation receives a new message.
reason.ambiguous_rules_same_priority: Several rules with the same priority match
reason.another_rule_negated: Another rule matched only with negation
reason.avatar_conflicts_with_known_name: Avatar differs from the known customer with this name
reason.composer_not_empty_owner_may_be_t: Input box not empty: owner may be typing
reason.conversation_title_mismatch: Opened conversation title does not match
reason.duplicate_nickname_in_frame: Same name appears in several rows
reason.latest_bubble_not_incoming: Latest bubble is not incoming (already replied?)
reason.new_with_old_activity: Activity time is old: possibly a historical customer outside the baseline
reason.new_without_incoming_evidence: No unread badge: could be outgoing or read elsewhere
reason.possible_rename_avatar_match: Avatar matches a known customer (possible rename)
reason.precheck_passed_no_input_sent: Precheck passed; no input sent (dry run)
reason.similar_name_possible_ocr_error_o: Similar to a known name (OCR error or rename?)
reason.superseded_by_new_incoming: A newer incoming message replaced this unsent reply
replies.intro: Every reply is tied to one detected incoming message. Sending verifies the target conversation and the sent bubble; anything uncertain pauses automatic replies.
review.intro: Items the monitor could not decide safely: ambiguous identities, OCR uncertainty, possible renames, or new conversations without incoming evidence.
rules.intro: Rules are evaluated only for confident incoming messages. Sensitive topics, attachments, negation, truncated text and ambiguous matches go to review. New rules are disabled until you enable them.
setting.capture_failure_pause_after: Pause replies after N capture failures
setting.layout_failure_pause_after: Pause replies after N layout failures
setting.new_customer_max_age_minutes: Max activity age for new-customer alert (minutes)
setting.reply_debounce_seconds: Wait before replying to a message burst (seconds)
setting.reply_max_per_customer_per_day: Max replies per customer per day
settings.intro: Safety switches (mode, dry run, emails, reply mode, reply sending) are on the Overview page and require confirmation.
settings.static_hint: Set through the private environment file; secrets are redacted here.
